incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: ERROR_RATE spike for customer 'marigold' on dedicated VPC pool mgd-pool-7 (canary slice). Severity: P1. Rolling aggregate error 5m = 14% (>5% threshold). Paging oncall.
Aisha (oncall): I'm on it, acknowledging the page. Can someone pull the canary dashboard and confirm which artifact is pinned? @Priya @Tom
Tom (sre): Confirmed. Canary slice is running artifact gh:fa3c9b2 (deployed 02:18 UTC). CPU and 95p latency are ok, but token gen errors are mostly 500s from runtime on kv-cache misses. Logs show repeated KV miss + bad deserializations.
Priya (platform): Looks like the canary pool got a new optimized kernel build earlier today. Possible ABI regression with KV deserializers. I see a pinned artifact though — mgd-pool-7 has "artifact_pin: gh:fa3c9b2" in the pool config.
Maria (devops): Copy. Customer contact is on standby: Marigold Ops and Sana in the thread. @Marigold Ops can you confirm impact on your side? Are requests failing for production users or only canary traffic?
Marigold Ops: We're seeing 20% of sessions for a small subset of customers failing with 500s. Our router sends ~10% traffic to canary slice for blue-green test. Impact is real but not all users. We can temporarily reduce canary traffic. Primary concern: data isolation — we need tenant marigold-42 isolated if we divert.
Sana (customer-success): We notified the Marigold network ops and they prefer controlled rollback rather than traffic cut if possible.
Aisha (oncall): Plan proposal: 1) Divert canary traffic off mgd-pool-7 to stable pool mgd-pool-2 (slice diversion). 2) Unpin artifact on mgd-pool-7 and roll it back to previous artifact gh:9d4b1a0. 3) If rollback fails, isolate marigold-42 tenant to a quarantine slice. Who can run the rollback/unpin? @Jae @Priya
Jae (eng-runtime): I can run artifact unpin + orchestrated rollback. Will coordinate with Maria for node drains.
Tom (sre): I'll prepare a short mitigation playbook and open a runbook link: https://console.redwood.ai/runbooks/mgd-canary-rollback
incident-bot: Incident created INC-2026-3845. Assigned: Aisha (oncall). SLA: 99.9. Incident channel: #incidents.
Maria (devops): Executing traffic slice diversion now: shifting canary percentage from 10% -> 0% over 30s for marigold route. Command (internal):
```
redwood route update --customer marigold --slice canary --weight 0 --target mgd-pool-2
```
Maria (devops): Diversion started. Monitoring ingress: https://console.redwood.ai/customers/marigold/traffic
Aisha (oncall): Results? Any drop in errors after diversion completes?
Tom (sre): Early signals: error rate dropped from 14% -> 4.2% within 90s. Good. But mgd-pool-7 still showing bad health for new connections (we need the rollback to reduce risk when canary traffic returns).
Jae (eng-runtime): Beginning artifact unpin and rollback to gh:9d4b1a0. Steps:
1) mark pool read-only for new deployments
2) unpin artifact
3) deploy previous artifact with canary=100 for the pool controller (local rollback)
4) verify smoke and health checks
Commands:
```
# mark pool read-only
redwood pool update mgd-pool-7 --accept-deploys=false
# remove artifact pin
redwood pool unpin-artifact mgd-pool-7
# rollback
redwood deploy --pool mgd-pool-7 --artifact gh:9d4b1a0 --force
```
Maria (devops): I'll drain active sessions on the pool before deploy: `redwood pool drain mgd-pool-7 --timeout 120` — doing now.
Marigold Ops: ETA on rollback? We might want traffic kept diverted until you confirm.
Jae (eng-runtime): Drain started, unpin command issued. Deploy in progress.
incident-bot: Deploy event: deploy-3845123456-rollback started by Jae
Tom (sre): Watching health checks. Also enabling extra logs for kv-deser at debug level for one minute:
```
redwood logs set-level --pool mgd-pool-7 --component kv-cache --level debug --duration 60s
```
Aisha (oncall): Noted. Keep me posted. Sana, notifying Marigold support that we're performing controlled rollback and traffic is diverted.
Sana (customer-success): Notified. They asked to keep them updated every 10 mins.
Maria (devops): Deploy finished. Health checks passing on new artifact gh:9d4b1a0. Post-deploy error rate on pool now 0.8%.
Jae (eng-runtime): Running verification suite against marigold-42 tenant endpoints (sanity requests). All sane. KV miss exceptions not reproducing in logs.
Tom (sre): Good. I'm watching APM traces — p95 latency stable. I recommend we keep canary traffic at 0% for 30 minutes and then gradually ramp to 5% with tight monitoring.
Marigold Ops: That sounds OK. We'll want a follow-up for a canary re-test window tomorrow 02:00 UTC.
Aisha (oncall): Action items captured. I'll leave incident open for monitoring and follow-up. Final immediate actions:
- Traffic diverted to mgd-pool-2 (Maria)
- Artifact unpinned and rollback to gh:9d4b1a0 (Jae)
- Drains + extra logs during window (Maria/Tom)
- Customer notified (Sana/Marigold Ops)
Time notes: diversion started ~3845123470, deploy finished ~3845123590. Marking current status: mitigated, customer-visible errors reduced. Keeping channel open for postmortem and RCA.
Priya (platform): Please file a postmortem with root cause hypothesis: kernel ABI mismatch causing serialization exceptions on specific runtime path when kv-cache misses occur. Assign to eng-runtime and eng-ml to reproduce. Suggest pinning artifact policy change to require automated smoke on local pool before pin.
Aisha (oncall): Will create INC PM and assign. Thanks folks. :thumbsup:
Marigold Ops: Thank you. We'll confirm once our internal dashboards are green and will coordinate the re-test window with Redwood.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-3845 status=mitigated, owner=Aisha (oncall).
